# Data Science for Biology Workshop Series
:::



:::{.g-col-8}

## Introduction to Bioinformatics & AI

**16–17 July 2026 · Gaborone, Botswana**

**Who is it for?**

Researchers working with sequencing data in health and disease who want a
foundation in bioinformatics, AI, and data science. No command line experience
necessary; some data analysis in R is a plus.

**Content covered:**

Where biological data comes from, and what AI actually is.

Machine learning for biologists — and when *not* to use it.

The bioinformatics pipeline: quality control, mapping, genotyping, phylogenetics.

A hands-on case study using real Botswana genomic data.

### [PreAssessment](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/zmADzApJ7v){target="_blank"}

Please complete the PreAssessment before the workshop begins.

## Before you arrive

1. Complete the [PreAssessment](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/zmADzApJ7v){target="_blank"}.
2. Install R, RStudio, and Quarto — see [Installation](installation-instructions.qmd).
